story.body: You set the day's length and refused the stop. No sum was spoken.

title: Left the Bear and set the ride through Oxford

story.body: You kept the horse at a walk. You repeated the question, called your own answer the answer of a man who wanted a different ask, and separated a king from her. You ended on the instruction to go back with one.

title: Said her question over and rode through Oxford

participation.context: Wrote one sentence and shut the tables.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You wrote the one sentence about the horse. The mend was already done, and you did not open a new place for it.

title: Wrote that the horse governs the day

participation.context: Wrote the short page and did not continue it into a speech.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You wrote the counting rhythm and three counted things, and you refused to mix them with her question. The page stops. The play is not begun.

title: Wrote a line or two of the counting rhythm
